speeds.title: Speeds
speeds.hint: Applies live, no restart. Defaults are the values proven on the 2026-08 flight tests — change them with a replayed recording that shows why.

takeoffRollHold.label: Take-off roll hold above
takeoffRollHold.hint: Above this IAS the roll is kept even if take-off thrust momentarily reads unset (FLEX detent bounce)

rolloutComplete.label: Rollout complete below
rolloutComplete.hint: Landing rollout becomes Taxi In once IAS drops below this

pushbackMax.label: Pushback max ground speed
pushbackMax.hint: Beacon + APU above this ground speed is a taxi, not a push

parkedBelow.label: Parked below
parkedBelow.hint: Ground speed below which the aircraft counts as stopped (hardware cockpits idle at 1–2 kt)

initialClimb.label: Initial climb ceiling
initialClimb.hint: Below this radio altitude a departure stays Initial Climb

levelBand.label: Level flight band
levelBand.hint: |VS| below this is level; above it a climb

approachCeiling.label: Approach ceiling
approachCeiling.hint: Descending (or gear-down level) below this radio altitude is Approach

goAroundRate.label: Go-around climb rate
goAroundRate.hint: Leaving Approach upward needs at least this VS — a level-off blip must not read as a go-around

descentEntry.label: Descent entry rate
descentEntry.hint: Entering Descent needs a sink rate at least this decisive

descentExit.label: Descent exit rate
descentExit.hint: Once descending, a segment shallower than this still counts as descent

cruise.title: Cruise gate
cruise.hint: Level flight only reads as Cruise near the FMS cruise altitude (a SID level-off is not cruise)

floor.label: Floor without FMS cruise
floor.hint: With no cruise altitude entered, level flight must be above this

agreement.label: Ground contact agreement
agreement.hint: Consecutive samples (250 ms each) the on-ground flag must agree before ground/air flips; 1 disables the filter

turnaround.label: Turnaround hold
turnaround.hint: After deboarding completes, parked (engines off, brake set, beacon off) for this long goes Shutdown → Preflight without a cold-and-dark reset

heartbeat.label: Heartbeat log interval
heartbeat.hint: A 'still thinking' log line while live; 0 disables

pause.title: MSFS pause
pause.hint: Escape in MSFS leaves the flight session for a moment. Within the grace, with the aircraft where it was, the phase and its latches are kept and 'Flight live' simply goes off and on again; longer, or a respawn, resets the phase like leaving to the menu.

grace.label: Pause grace
grace.hint: How long the session may be away (with MSFS's pause flag set) before it counts as a real session end; 0 resets at once

position.label: Same position within
position.hint: On resume the aircraft must be this close to where it was; farther is a respawn

fuel.label: Same fuel within
fuel.hint: On resume the fuel on board must be this close to the pre-pause figure; a bigger jump is a reload

settle.title: Settle times
settle.hint: How long a transition's evidence must persist before it commits

descentToCruise.label: Descent → Cruise
descentToCruise.hint: Level segments of a step descent must not flip-flop

cruiseToClimb.label: Cruise → Climb
cruiseToClimb.hint: A VS blip at cruise is turbulence; a step climb sustains

descentToClimb.label: Descent → Climb
descentToClimb.hint: A level-off in the descent wobbles upward for a few seconds; a climb-back on ATC instruction sustains

departureRegression.label: Departure regression
departureRegression.hint: Walking Pushback/Taxi Out/Take-off Roll back to Preflight needs sustained contradiction

firstAirborne.label: First airborne classification
firstAirborne.hint: A session whose first classification is a flight phase (mid-flight restart or warm-up garbage) must sustain this long

recorder.title: Flight recorder
recorder.hint: Compact per-second samples in the session log so any flight can be replayed through the phase engine offline (see docs/agents/flight-verification.md)

keepAlive.label: Keep-alive
keepAlive.hint: Unchanged samples are skipped; one is still written at least this often

rules.title: Rule table
rules.hint: Evaluation order, first match wins. 'hold' keeps the current phase. Read-only — the rules live in code; the thresholds above feed them.
